title: Add a routing_policy field to the chat completion request
agentPrompt: Our gateway needs to know which routing policy to use per request. Add a routing_policy field to the chat completion request model so callers can specify it.
whyItLooksFine: One added line on a dataclass. No logic changed, no test broken — the existing contract test suite passes, because every assertion in it is about the fields that were already there. A reviewer skimming the diff sees an additive change to a request model, which is the single most common and most routinely-approved kind of API change.
whatIsActuallyWrong: The field has no default and a non-optional type, so it is required. Every existing client that does not send routing_policy starts failing validation the moment this deploys. The version registry was not touched, so there is no record a client could pin against and no second reviewer was pulled in. And the contract test was not updated, so the suite is green while asserting nothing about the new shape.

edits.find:
model: str
    messages: list[ChatMessage]
    max_tokens: int | None = None
edits.replace:
model: str
    messages: list[ChatMessage]
    routing_policy: str
    max_tokens: int | None = None

engine_request = render_chat_request(request)
        engine_request.routing_policy = request.routing_policy
        result = await self._engine.generate(engine_request)

expect.notes: This is the brief's headline case: valid-looking diff, violates a documented decision. ADR-0000 is in mustNotFlag because it is superseded — if it fires, ADR status is being ignored.
